content:
So long, old money.

 

This year, self-made fortunes hit a record share of billionaire wealth.

 

Good news?

 

Not for me.

 

Back when billionaires were corrupt bastards born into old money, I had the perfect excuse not to be one.

 

I'm not a corrupt bastard, let alone born into old money.
No point in even trying to become a billionaire.

 

But now,
you don’t need political connections anymore, you don't need to inherit great fortunes.

 

Anyone can become a billionaire.
Even good people!

 

So, no more excuses my friends.

 

If I'm not a billionaire, it’s my own fault.
I should have worked harder instead of scrolling through another TikTok video.

 

Happy Friday, future billionaires!

 

Chart by The Economist

images.alt: Line chart titled Less murky, more Messi shows billionaire wealth from competitive activities rising 2001–2025.

headline: Record share of billionaire wealth goes to self-made fortunes
description: Self-made fortunes now dominate billionaire wealth; old money barriers fade, anyone can become a billionaire, even good people.
